question: Parliament passes ‘Bills of Lading, 2025’ to modernize maritime law in India. What does the Bills of Lading Bill, 2025 aim to replace?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Indian Bills of Lading Act, 1856**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Parliament passes ‘Bills of Lading, 2025’ to modernize maritime law in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Bills of Lading Bill, 2025** has been **passed by Parliament**, with the **Rajya Sabha** approving it and the **Lok Sabha** already having passed it in **March 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The bill seeks to **update and simplify** the **legal framework for shipping documents**.

 
 
• 
 
It will **replace** the **Indian Bills of Lading Act, 1856**, a **colonial-era law**.

 
 
• 
 
A **bill of lading** is a document issued by a **freight carrier to a shipper**, detailing the **type, quantity, condition, and destination** of goods.
